description: This file defines a React component for a sidebar navigation menu, including logic for active state determination based on current URL path, rendering navigation items with styling, and handling mobile/desktop responsiveness.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a URL path by removing trailing slashes except for root.

methods.name: startsWithPathSegment
methods.description: Checks if a pathname starts with a given base segment, matching route groups.

methods.name: isNavItemActive
methods.description: Determines if a navigation item should be considered active based on current route.
